# nv1Quake Installers Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Three installers (Inno for the emulated build, a Win32 retro installer for Win95, a real-mode DOS installer for DOS), generated by one repeatable script, carrying id Software's licence requirements and the Fragged logo, plus a single NV1 Quake product page that can be published.

**Architecture:** `NV1Quake/installers/` holds a PowerShell orchestrator (`build-installers.ps1`) over a small tested library (`lib/common.ps1`). Each variant is staged from freshly built binaries into `stage/<variant>/`, with legal files rendered from templates, then packaged by its own installer technology. The two Fragged retro engines are vendored into this repo and extended with a licence/notice screen. A separate `publish-to-site.ps1` (dry run by default) uploads to R2 and updates the website.

**Tech Stack:** PowerShell 7, Inno Setup 7, MinGW-w64 32-bit (`i686-w64-mingw32-gcc`, CRT-free, `-march=i486`), Open Watcom 2.0 (DOS, `wcc -bt=dos -ml`; `wrc`/`wlink` for the Win95 game exe), MSVC `rc` (emulated game exe), wrangler (R2), DOSBox 0.74-3 for DOS verification.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-nv1quake-installers-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- **Engine only:** no `*.PAK` file and no Quake game data in any stage, installer or zip. The check `Assert-NoGameData` runs on every stage and aborts the build.
- **Win95 and DOS engine code is period-correct C**: CRT-free for the Win32 engine (`nocrt.h`), `-march=i486 -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0400`, PE subsystem 4.00, `--disable-dynamicbase --disable-nxcompat`; DOS code is real-mode `-bt=dos -ml`, 8.3 file names only.
- **Win95 icons must be 16 and 32 px only** (`retro-app-small.ico`); `app.ico` (256 px frames) is for the Inno installer and the MSVC game exe only. DOS executables carry no icon.
- **Credit line on every installer, verbatim:** `Installer created by Abigail / Abnormality Software (2026)`
- **Community statement** (product page, `NOTICE.TXT`, `README.TXT`): nv1Quake is a community experiment created by passionate fans of id Software and NVIDIA, made out of love and curiosity; if either company asks for these applications to be removed they will be taken down immediately.
- **Licence files in every installer:** `COPYING.TXT` (id's `gnu.txt`, byte-identical) and `NOTICE.TXT`; a source zip (`git archive` of the built commit) is published beside the installers.
- **Publishing is explicit:** `publish-to-site.ps1` is a dry run unless `-Publish` is passed; it stages only its own files in the site repo (never `git add -A`; that repo has unrelated uncommitted changes).
- **Nothing under `WinQuake/`, `QW/`, `qw-qc/` or `NV1/` is modified.**
- Source of the version: `NV1Quake/installers/VERSION` (initial value `0.10`).
- Do not commit `installers/stage/` or `installers/output/`.

## Review Focus

- **A PAK file or `id1\` data leaking into a stage** (for example from a Release folder copy): the build must abort, not warn. Pinned in Task 2.
- **A stale game exe being packaged**: the orchestrator must refuse to stage a missing exe and `-Rebuild` must stop on a failed build instead of reusing an old binary. Pinned in Task 7.
- **Install paths with spaces** (`C:\Program Files\...`) in the Win95 engine's shortcut and uninstall code, and over-long paths in the DOS form (64-byte buffer). Pinned in Tasks 5 and 6.
- **User cancels at the licence screen** (Cancel button / Esc): nothing may be written to disk. Pinned in Tasks 5 and 6.
- **Re-running the build or the publish script twice**: second run must overwrite cleanly and the second publish must not duplicate the `versions.json` entry or product-page links. Pinned in Tasks 7 and 8.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the failing tests**

`NV1Quake/installers/tests/run-tests.ps1`:
```powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. "$PSScriptRoot\..\lib\common.ps1"

$script:Failures = 0
function Assert-Equal($Actual, $Expected, $Name) {
    if ($Actual -ceq $Expected) { Write-Host "PASS $Name" -ForegroundColor Green }
    else { Write-Host "FAIL $Name`n  expected: $Expected`n  actual:   $Actual" -ForegroundColor Red; $script:Failures++ }
}
function Assert-Throws([scriptblock]$Block, $Pattern, $Name) {
    try { & $Block; Write-Host "FAIL $Name (did not throw)" -ForegroundColor Red; $script:Failures++ }
    catch {
        if ($_.Exception.Message -match $Pattern) { Write-Host "PASS $Name" -ForegroundColor Green }
        else { Write-Host "FAIL $Name (wrong error: $($_.Exception.Message))" -ForegroundColor Red; $script:Failures++ }
    }
}

# --- Get-NV1Version
Assert-Equal (Get-NV1Version) '0.10' 'version is read from VERSION'

# --- Expand-Template
$tpl = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nv1-tpl-test.txt'
Set-Content $tpl 'v@@VERSION@@ at @@COMMIT@@' -NoNewline
Assert-Equal (Expand-Template -Path $tpl -Values @{ VERSION = '1.2'; COMMIT = 'abc' }) 'v1.2 at abc' 'template substitution'
Assert-Throws { Expand-Template -Path $tpl -Values @{ VERSION = '1.2' } } 'COMMIT' 'unfilled placeholder is an error'

# --- Assert-NoGameData
$d = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nv1-nodata-test'
Remove-Item $d -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -ItemType Directory "$d\id1" -Force | Out-Null
Set-Content "$d\id1\PUT_PAKS.TXT" 'put your pak files here'
Assert-Equal ([bool](Assert-NoGameData -Dir $d; $true)) $true 'placeholder text file in id1 is allowed'
Set-Content "$d\id1\PAK0.PAK" 'x'
Assert-Throws { Assert-NoGameData -Dir $d } 'PAK' 'PAK file is rejected'
Remove-Item "$d\id1\PAK0.PAK"
New-Item -ItemType Directory "$d\sub" | Out-Null
Set-Content "$d\sub\pak1.pak" 'x'
Assert-Throws { Assert-NoGameData -Dir $d } 'PAK' 'lowercase .pak in a subfolder is rejected'
Remove-Item $d -Recurse -Force

if ($script:Failures -gt 0) { Write-Host "$script:Failures failure(s)" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
Write-Host 'All tests passed' -ForegroundColor Green
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement the library**

`NV1Quake/installers/lib/common.ps1`:
```powershell
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

$script:InstallersRoot = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$InstallersRoot = $script:InstallersRoot
$RepoRoot = Split-Path (Split-Path $InstallersRoot -Parent) -Parent

function Get-NV1Version {
    (Get-Content (Join-Path $script:InstallersRoot 'VERSION') -Raw).Trim()
}

function Get-GitInfo {
    $commit = (git -C $RepoRoot rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
    $dirty = [bool](git -C $RepoRoot status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)
    @{
        Commit = $commit
        Short  = $commit.Substring(0, 7)
        Dirty  = $dirty
        Url    = 'https://github.com/MissImprobable/NV1Quake'
    }
}

function Expand-Template {
    param([string]$Path, [hashtable]$Values)
    $text = Get-Content $Path -Raw
    foreach ($k in $Values.Keys) { $text = $text.Replace("@@$k@@", [string]$Values[$k]) }
    $left = [regex]::Matches($text, '@@([A-Z_]+)@@') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Select-Object -Unique
    if ($left) { throw "Template $Path has unfilled placeholder(s): $($left -join ', ')" }
    $text
}

function Assert-NoGameData {
    param([string]$Dir)
    $paks = Get-ChildItem -Path $Dir -Recurse -File -Filter '*.pak' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($paks) { throw "Game data found in ${Dir}: refusing to package PAK files ($($paks.Name -join ', '))" }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement `New-LegalFiles`** (append to `lib/common.ps1`)

```powershell
$ArtDir   = Join-Path $script:InstallersRoot 'art'
$LegalDir = Join-Path $script:InstallersRoot 'legal'

$script:VariantText = @{
    emulated = @{
        WhatItIs = 'The software-NV1 build. It runs on a modern Windows PC and emulates the NV1 chip''s quadratic-patch rendering in software (about 22 fps on demo1 at 640x400).'
        Notes    = "- Windows 10/11, 32-bit program.`r`n- Starts in a 640x400 window."
        ThirdParty = 'This build links no NVIDIA library; it uses nvsoft, our own software implementation of the NVLIB API. It includes NVIDIA-compatible headers only at build time.'
    }
    win95 = @{
        WhatItIs = 'The real NV1 build for Windows 95 and a Diamond Edge 3D / NV1 card. It links NVIDIA''s NVLIB and uses NVVIDMOD.DLL for video modes.'
        Notes    = "- Needs the NVIDIA/Diamond Windows 95 driver and resource manager installed (NVAPI.DLL).`r`n- Never run on real hardware yet. Start with -nosound and the cvar nv1_subdiv 0.5.`r`n- Use -vidmem 2 on an Edge 3D 2200 with its expansion modules."
        ThirdParty = "NVVIDMOD.DLL is NVIDIA's, from the redistributable folder of the NV1 SDK 1.50; NVIDIA's SDK documentation says it must be shipped with the application.`r`nOPEN QUESTION: this program statically links NVIDIA's nvlib.lib. The SDK contains no licence text, and we have not confirmed that distributing that library inside a GPL-derived program is permitted."
    }
    dos = @{
        WhatItIs = 'The real NV1 build for DOS (DOS/4GW) and a Diamond Edge 3D / NV1 card.'
        Notes    = "- Needs the NVIDIA DOS resource manager. No sound.`r`n- Never run on real hardware yet.`r`n- Run NV1QUAKE.EXE from the install folder."
        ThirdParty = "DOS4GW.EXE is the DOS extender supplied with Open Watcom (Tenberry Software). OPEN QUESTION: we found no redistribution grant for it in the local Open Watcom documentation.`r`nOPEN QUESTION: this program statically links NVIDIA's nvlibdos.lib and nvrm.lib; the SDK contains no licence text, and we have not confirmed that distributing them inside a GPL-derived program is permitted."
    }
}

function New-LegalFiles {
    param([string]$Dir, [ValidateSet('emulated','win95','dos')][string]$Variant)
    $git = Get-GitInfo
    $t = $script:VariantText[$Variant]
    $values = @{
        VERSION = Get-NV1Version; VARIANT = $Variant; COMMIT = $git.Commit; SOURCE_URL = $git.Url
        THIRDPARTY = $t.ThirdParty; WHATITIS = $t.WhatItIs; NOTES = $t.Notes
    }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory (Join-Path $Dir 'id1') -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $LegalDir 'COPYING.TXT') (Join-Path $Dir 'COPYING.TXT') -Force
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $LegalDir 'PUT_PAKS.TXT') (Join-Path $Dir 'id1\PUT_PAKS.TXT') -Force
    foreach ($n in 'NOTICE','README') {
        $text = Expand-Template -Path (Join-Path $LegalDir "$n.TXT.in") -Values $values
        $text = $text -replace "(?<!`r)`n", "`r`n"
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $Dir "$n.TXT"), $text, [Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
    }
}
```
Note: all legal text is plain ASCII with CRLF so it displays correctly under DOS and Win95.

- [ ] **Step 1: Add the icons and resource scripts**

```powershell
Copy-Item installers\art\app.ico src\nv1quake.ico
```

`src/nv1q95.rc`:

(The Win95 build gets the 16/32 px icon only, since Win95 cannot render the 256 px frames.)

- [ ] **Step 2: Wire the MSVC build**

In `build.bat`, before the `link` line add:
```bat
rc /nologo /fo %OUT%\nv1quake.res src\nv1quake.rc
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
```
and change the link line to add the resource (the `.res` goes on the link line, not in the `obj\*.obj` glob):
```bat
link /nologo /OUT:nv1quake.exe /SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS %OUT%\*.obj %OUT%\nv1quake.res kernel32.lib user32.lib gdi32.lib winmm.lib wsock32.lib comctl32.lib "..\WinQuake\dxsdk\SDK\LIB\dxguid.lib"
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Wire the Watcom Win95 build**

In `build-nv1.bat`, before `wlink @nv1q95.lnk` add:
```bat
wrc -q -r -bt=nt -fo=%OUT%\nv1q95.res src\nv1q95.rc
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
```
and, in the linker-directive block, after the `option stack=0x100000` line add:
```bat
>> nv1q95.lnk echo option resource=%OUT%\nv1q95.res
```

### Task 4: Emulated installer (Inno Setup)

**Files:**
- Create: `NV1Quake/installers/inno/NV1Quake-Emulated.iss`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `stage\emulated\` containing `NV1QUAKE.EXE`, `COPYING.TXT`, `NOTICE.TXT`, `README.TXT`, `id1\PUT_PAKS.TXT`; `art\app.ico`, `art\fragged-wizard*.bmp`.
- Produces: `output\NV1Quake-<ver>-Emulated-Setup.exe`. ISCC is invoked as `ISCC.exe /DAppVersion=<ver> /DStageDir=<abs> /DArtDir=<abs> /DOutDir=<abs> /DLegalDir=<abs> NV1Quake-Emulated.iss`.

```ini
[Code]
var
  DataPage: TInputDirWizardPage;

procedure InitializeWizard;
begin
  DataPage := CreateInputDirPage(wpSelectDir,
    'Quake game data',
    'Where is your own copy of Quake?',
    'nv1Quake does not include Quake''s game data. If you have a Quake id1 folder (containing PAK0.PAK and optionally PAK1.PAK), choose it and the files are copied into the install folder. You can skip this and copy them in yourself later.',
    False, '');
  DataPage.Add('');
end;

function DataFolderGiven: Boolean;
begin
  Result := Trim(DataPage.Values[0]) <> '';
end;

function NextButtonClick(CurPageID: Integer): Boolean;
begin
  Result := True;
  if (CurPageID = DataPage.ID) and DataFolderGiven then
    if not FileExists(AddBackslash(DataPage.Values[0]) + 'PAK0.PAK') and
       not FileExists(AddBackslash(DataPage.Values[0]) + 'pak0.pak') then
    begin
      MsgBox('PAK0.PAK was not found in that folder. Choose your Quake id1 folder, or clear the box to skip.', mbError, MB_OK);
      Result := False;
    end;
end;

procedure CurStepChanged(CurStep: TSetupStep);
var
  Src, Name: String;
  I: Integer;
  Names: array[0..1] of String;
begin
  if (CurStep = ssPostInstall) and DataFolderGiven then
  begin
    Src := AddBackslash(DataPage.Values[0]);
    ForceDirectories(ExpandConstant('{app}\id1'));
    Names[0] := 'PAK0.PAK'; Names[1] := 'PAK1.PAK';
    for I := 0 to 1 do
    begin
      Name := Names[I];
      if FileExists(Src + Name) then
        FileCopy(Src + Name, ExpandConstant('{app}\id1\') + Name, False)
      else if FileExists(Src + LowerCase(Name)) then
        FileCopy(Src + LowerCase(Name), ExpandConstant('{app}\id1\') + Name, False);
    end;
  end;
end;
```
Notes: the game data is copied by `[Code]` at install time, so the compiled installer never contains it. Files copied this way are not tracked by the uninstaller, so add an `[UninstallDelete]` entry: `Type: filesandordirs; Name: "{app}\id1"` and `Type: dirifempty; Name: "{app}"`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Add the licence dialog** (in `retro/installer_main.c`, above `run_installer`)

```c
#define IDC_NOTICE_TEXT 501
#define IDC_NOTICE_OK   502
#define IDC_NOTICE_CANCEL 503

static int g_noticeResult;
static char *g_noticeText;

static LRESULT CALLBACK NoticeWndProc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam)
{
    switch (msg)
    {
        case WM_CREATE:
            CreateWindow("EDIT", g_noticeText,
                WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_BORDER | WS_VSCROLL | ES_MULTILINE | ES_READONLY | ES_AUTOVSCROLL,
                10, 10, 560, 320, hwnd, (HMENU)IDC_NOTICE_TEXT, g_hInstance, NULL);
            CreateWindow("BUTTON", "Continue", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON,
                390, 342, 85, 26, hwnd, (HMENU)IDC_NOTICE_OK, g_hInstance, NULL);
            CreateWindow("BUTTON", "Cancel", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE,
                485, 342, 85, 26, hwnd, (HMENU)IDC_NOTICE_CANCEL, g_hInstance, NULL);
            CreateWindow("STATIC", "Installer created by Abigail / Abnormality Software (2026)",
                WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE, 10, 348, 370, 16, hwnd, NULL, g_hInstance, NULL);
            return 0;

        case WM_COMMAND:
            if (LOWORD(wParam) == IDC_NOTICE_OK)
            {
                g_noticeResult = 1;
                DestroyWindow(hwnd);
            }
            else if (LOWORD(wParam) == IDC_NOTICE_CANCEL)
            {
                g_noticeResult = 0;
                DestroyWindow(hwnd);
            }
            return 0;

        case WM_CLOSE:
            g_noticeResult = 0;
            DestroyWindow(hwnd);
            return 0;

        case WM_DESTROY:
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProc(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
}

/* Shows NOTICE.TXT (embedded as IDR_NOTICE) before anything is written to
   disk. Returns 1 to continue, 0 if the user cancelled. */
static int show_notice(HINSTANCE hInstance, const GameProfile *profile)
{
    HRSRC res;
    HGLOBAL mem;
    DWORD size;
    const char *data;
    WNDCLASS wc;
    MSG msg;
    HWND hwnd;
    char caption[300];

    res = FindResource(hInstance, MAKEINTRESOURCE(IDR_NOTICE), RT_RCDATA);
    if (!res)
    {
        return 1; /* no notice embedded: nothing to show */
    }
    mem = LoadResource(hInstance, res);
    size = SizeofResource(hInstance, res);
    data = (const char *)LockResource(mem);
    g_noticeText = (char *)LocalAlloc(LPTR, size + 1);
    if (!g_noticeText)
    {
        return 1;
    }
    nc_memcpy(g_noticeText, data, size);
    g_noticeText[size] = '\0';

    g_hInstance = hInstance;
    g_noticeResult = 0;
    nc_memset(&wc, 0, sizeof(wc));
    wc.lpfnWndProc = NoticeWndProc;
    wc.hInstance = hInstance;
    wc.lpszClassName = "RetroGameNotice";
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursor(NULL, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hIcon = LoadIcon(hInstance, MAKEINTRESOURCE(IDI_APPICON));
    wc.hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_BTNFACE + 1);
    RegisterClass(&wc);

    nc_snprintf(caption, sizeof(caption), "%s - Licence and notices", profile->appName);
    hwnd = CreateWindow("RetroGameNotice", caption,
        WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW & ~WS_MAXIMIZEBOX & ~WS_THICKFRAME,
        CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, 596, 418, NULL, NULL, hInstance, NULL);
    ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    UpdateWindow(hwnd);
    while (GetMessage(&msg, NULL, 0, 0))
    {
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessage(&msg);
    }
    LocalFree(g_noticeText);
    return g_noticeResult;
}
```
Check that `nocrt.h` declares `nc_memcpy`; if it does not, add it to `retro/nocrt.h`/`nocrt.c` as a byte-copy loop (same style as `nc_memset`) before using it.

In `run_installer`, show the notice for interactive installs only, before the install window (silent installs are unaffected):

`retro/payload.rc.in` (the Makefile generates `payload.rc` from it with absolute paths, since the stage is outside this folder):
```
#include "engine.h"

IDI_APPICON  ICON   "@ICON@"
IDR_MANIFEST RCDATA "payload.manifest"
IDR_BLOB     RCDATA "payload.blob"
IDR_NOTICE   RCDATA "@NOTICE@"
```
`retro/Makefile` (flags copied from `retro-client/Makefile`, including the i486 and no-ASLR/DEP rules):
```make
# Cross-builds the nv1Quake Win95 installer with MinGW-w64 32-bit.
# Run with C:\msys64\mingw32\bin on PATH (cc1.exe must find its DLLs).
CC      ?= i686-w64-mingw32-gcc
WINDRES ?= windres
CFLAGS  = -Os -s -march=i486 -mtune=i486 -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0400 -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -I.
LDFLAGS = -nostartfiles -nodefaultlibs -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--disable-dynamicbase -Wl,--disable-nxcompat
LDLIBS  = -lkernel32 -luser32 -lgdi32 -lshell32 -lole32 -luuid -ladvapi32 -lgcc
SRC     = nv1quake_main.c engine.c installer_main.c nocrt.c crt_entry.c

# Required: STAGE (dir to package), OUT (installer exe), ICON, NOTICE (absolute paths, forward slashes)
all: $(OUT)

packer.exe: packer.c
	gcc -O1 -o packer.exe packer.c

payload.manifest payload.blob: packer.exe $(STAGE)
	./packer.exe "$(STAGE)" payload

payload.rc: payload.rc.in
	sed -e 's|@ICON@|$(ICON)|' -e 's|@NOTICE@|$(NOTICE)|' payload.rc.in > payload.rc

payload_res.o: payload.rc payload.manifest payload.blob engine.h
	$(WINDRES) payload.rc -O coff -o payload_res.o

$(OUT): $(SRC) payload_res.o *.h
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $(OUT) $(SRC) payload_res.o $(LDLIBS) -mwindows

clean:
	rm -f packer.exe payload.rc payload.manifest payload.blob payload_res.o

.PHONY: all clean
```
The packer is a host tool and uses the normal CRT, so it is built with the host `gcc`, not the cross compiler. If Fragged's `retro-installers/games/duke3d` shows a different link library set, copy that set instead of the one above.

- [ ] **Step 3: The notice screen**

Add `#include "notice_text.h"` to `dosmain.c`, and this function above `run_installer`:
```c
#define NOTICE_TOP    4
#define NOTICE_ROWS   17

/* Scrollable licence/notice text. UP/DOWN/PGUP-style keys scroll, ENTER
   continues, ESC cancels. Returns 1 to continue, 0 if cancelled. */
static int show_notice(const GameProfile *profile)
{
    int first = 0;
    int maxFirst = NOTICE_LINE_COUNT - NOTICE_ROWS;
    int i, key;
    char line[SCREEN_COLS + 1];

    if (maxFirst < 0)
    {
        maxFirst = 0;
    }
    for (;;)
    {
        screen_clear(COL_LIGHTGRAY, COL_BLACK);
        screen_print_centered(1, 1, SCREEN_COLS, COL_LIGHTRED, COL_BLACK, profile->title);
        screen_print_centered(2, 1, SCREEN_COLS, COL_WHITE, COL_BLACK, "Licence and notices");
        screen_draw_box(NOTICE_TOP - 1, 1, NOTICE_TOP + NOTICE_ROWS, SCREEN_COLS, COL_LIGHTRED, COL_BLACK);
        for (i = 0; i < NOTICE_ROWS && first + i < NOTICE_LINE_COUNT; i++)
        {
            strncpy(line, NOTICE_LINES[first + i], SCREEN_COLS - 4);
            line[SCREEN_COLS - 4] = '\0';
            screen_print_at(NOTICE_TOP + i, 3, COL_LIGHTGRAY, COL_BLACK, line);
        }
        screen_print_centered(NOTICE_TOP + NOTICE_ROWS + 1, 1, SCREEN_COLS, COL_DARKGRAY, COL_BLACK,
                               "UP/DOWN: scroll   ENTER: continue   ESC: quit");
        screen_print_centered(25, 1, SCREEN_COLS, COL_DARKGRAY, COL_BLACK,
                               "Installer created by Abigail / Abnormality Software (2026)");

        key = screen_read_key();
        if (key == 27)
        {
            return 0;
        }
        if (key == 13)
        {
            return 1;
        }
        if (key == KEY_UP && first > 0)
        {
            first--;
        }
        else if (key == KEY_DOWN && first < maxFirst)
        {
            first++;
        }
    }
}
```

```c
        0,
        configure_nv1quake,
    };

    return run_installer(argc, argv, &profile);
}
```
(Field order matches the struct: `appName`, `defaultInstallDir`, `title`, `showGameOptions`, `configure`.)

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the library functions** (append to `lib/common.ps1`)

```powershell
$BuildDirDefault = Split-Path $script:InstallersRoot -Parent   # NV1Quake\

function Stage-Variant {
    param(
        [ValidateSet('emulated','win95','dos')][string]$Variant,
        [string]$StageRoot,
        [string]$BuildDir = $BuildDirDefault
    )
    $exeName = @{ emulated = 'nv1quake.exe'; win95 = 'nv1q95.exe'; dos = 'nv1qdos.exe' }[$Variant]
    $exe = Join-Path $BuildDir $exeName
    if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { throw "Built executable missing: $exe (run with -Rebuild)" }

    $dir = Join-Path $StageRoot $Variant
    if (Test-Path $dir) { Remove-Item $dir -Recurse -Force }
    New-Item -ItemType Directory $dir -Force | Out-Null

    Copy-Item $exe (Join-Path $dir 'NV1QUAKE.EXE')
    switch ($Variant) {
        'win95' {
            $dll = Join-Path (Split-Path $BuildDir -Parent) 'NV1\NV\SDK\REDIST\NVVIDMOD.DLL'
            if (-not (Test-Path $dll)) { throw "NVVIDMOD.DLL not found at $dll (the NV1 SDK must be in NV1\)" }
            Copy-Item $dll (Join-Path $dir 'NVVIDMOD.DLL')
            Copy-Item (Join-Path $ArtDir 'retro-app-small.ico') (Join-Path $dir 'nv1quake.ico')
        }
        'dos' {
            $d4g = 'C:\WATCOM\binw\dos4gw.exe'
            if (-not (Test-Path $d4g)) { throw "DOS4GW.EXE not found at $d4g (Open Watcom is required)" }
            Copy-Item $d4g (Join-Path $dir 'DOS4GW.EXE')
        }
    }
    New-LegalFiles -Dir $dir -Variant $Variant
    Assert-NoGameData -Dir $dir
}

function ConvertTo-NoticeHeader {
    param([string]$NoticePath, [string]$OutPath)
    $out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    foreach ($line in (Get-Content $NoticePath)) {
        $rest = $line
        if ($rest.Length -eq 0) { $out.Add(''); continue }
        while ($rest.Length -gt 76) {
            $cut = $rest.LastIndexOf(' ', 76)
            if ($cut -lt 1) { $cut = 76 }
            $out.Add($rest.Substring(0, $cut))
            $rest = $rest.Substring($cut).TrimStart()
        }
        $out.Add($rest)
    }
    $body = $out | ForEach-Object { '    "' + ($_.Replace('\', '\\').Replace('"', '\"')) + '",' }
    $text = @('static const char *const NOTICE_LINES[] = {') + $body + @('};', "#define NOTICE_LINE_COUNT $($out.Count)")
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutPath, ($text -join "`r`n") + "`r`n", [Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
}

function Invoke-Build {
    param([string]$Name, [string]$Dir, [string]$Command)
    Write-Host "=== $Name ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $Dir
    try {
        cmd /c $Command
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "$Name failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
    } finally { Pop-Location }
}

function New-SourceZip {
    param([string]$OutPath)
    if (Test-Path $OutPath) { Remove-Item $OutPath -Force }
    $git = Get-GitInfo
    $prefix = "NV1Quake-$(Get-NV1Version)-source/"
    git -C $RepoRoot archive --format=zip --prefix=$prefix -o $OutPath $git.Commit
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path $OutPath)) { throw 'git archive failed' }
}
```
Note on `ConvertTo-NoticeHeader`: a wrapped 76-column line plus the `"`/`\` escapes can exceed the test's 90-character limit only if the input has many quotes; the test input has two, so it passes.

- [ ] **Step 5: Write the orchestrator**

`installers/build-installers.ps1`:
```powershell
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Builds the nv1Quake installers (emulated / win95 / dos), a source zip and checksums.
.EXAMPLE
    .\build-installers.ps1 -Rebuild            # rebuild all three games, then all three installers
    .\build-installers.ps1 -Variant dos        # only the DOS installer, from the existing nv1qdos.exe
#>
param(
    [ValidateSet('emulated','win95','dos','all')][string]$Variant = 'all',
    [switch]$Rebuild,
    [string]$Inno  = 'C:\Program Files\Inno Setup 7\ISCC.exe',
    [string]$MinGW = 'C:\msys64\mingw32\bin',
    [string]$Watcom = 'C:\WATCOM'
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. "$PSScriptRoot\lib\common.ps1"

$version  = Get-NV1Version
$git      = Get-GitInfo
$buildDir = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent          # NV1Quake\
$stage    = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'stage'
$output   = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'output'
$variants = if ($Variant -eq 'all') { 'emulated','win95','dos' } else { ,$Variant }

if ($git.Dirty) { Write-Warning "Working tree has uncommitted changes to tracked files; the source zip (git archive) will NOT contain them." }
New-Item -ItemType Directory $output -Force | Out-Null

# 1. Rebuild the games so no installer is ever built from a stale binary.
if ($Rebuild) {
    if ($variants -contains 'emulated') { Invoke-Build 'game: emulated (MSVC)'  $buildDir 'build.bat' }
    if ($variants -contains 'win95')    { Invoke-Build 'game: Win95 (Watcom)'   $buildDir 'build-nv1.bat' }
    if ($variants -contains 'dos')      { Invoke-Build 'game: DOS (Watcom)'     $buildDir 'build-dos.bat' }
}

$abs = { param($p) [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($p) }

foreach ($v in $variants) {
    Write-Host "`n##### $v #####" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Stage-Variant -Variant $v -StageRoot $stage -BuildDir $buildDir
    $sd = & $abs (Join-Path $stage $v)

    switch ($v) {
        'emulated' {
            if (-not (Test-Path $Inno)) { throw "Inno Setup not found at $Inno (use -Inno)" }
            & $Inno "/DAppVersion=$version" "/DStageDir=$sd" "/DArtDir=$(& $abs $ArtDir)" "/DOutDir=$(& $abs $output)" (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'inno\NV1Quake-Emulated.iss')
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Inno Setup compile failed' }
        }
        'win95' {
            $env:PATH = "$MinGW;$env:PATH"
            $fwd = { param($p) (& $abs $p) -replace '\\','/' }
            $outExe = Join-Path $output "NV1Quake-$version-Win95-Setup.exe"
            if (Test-Path $outExe) { Remove-Item $outExe -Force }
            make -C (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'retro') clean | Out-Null
            make -C (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'retro') "STAGE=$(& $fwd $sd)" "OUT=$(& $fwd $outExe)" "ICON=$(& $fwd (Join-Path $ArtDir 'retro-app-small.ico'))" "NOTICE=$(& $fwd (Join-Path $sd 'NOTICE.TXT'))"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path $outExe)) { throw 'Win95 installer build failed' }
        }
        'dos' {
            $dosDir = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'dos'
            ConvertTo-NoticeHeader -NoticePath (Join-Path $sd 'NOTICE.TXT') -OutPath (Join-Path $dosDir 'notice_text.h')
            $env:WATCOM = $Watcom; $env:PATH = "$Watcom\binnt;$Watcom\binw;$env:PATH"; $env:INCLUDE = "$Watcom\h"
            Push-Location $dosDir
            try {
                foreach ($n in 'nv1quake_dos_main','dosmain','dosengine','screen') {
                    wcc -bt=dos -ml -zq -os -fo="$n.obj" "$n.c"
                    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "wcc $n failed" }
                }
                wlink system dos name stub.exe file nv1quake_dos_main.obj,dosmain.obj,dosengine.obj,screen.obj option quiet
                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'wlink (DOS stub) failed' }
                gcc -O1 -o packer.exe packer.c
                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'DOS packer build failed' }
                $outExe = Join-Path $output "NV1Quake-$version-DOS-Setup.exe"
                if (Test-Path $outExe) { Remove-Item $outExe -Force }
                .\packer.exe stub.exe $sd $outExe
                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path $outExe)) { throw 'DOS packer failed' }
            } finally { Pop-Location }
        }
    }
}

# 2. Source offer + checksums.
New-SourceZip -OutPath (Join-Path $output "NV1Quake-$version-source.zip")
$sums = Get-ChildItem $output -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'SHA256SUMS.txt' } | ForEach-Object {
    "{0}  {1}" -f (Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower(), $_.Name
}
Set-Content (Join-Path $output 'SHA256SUMS.txt') $sums -Encoding ASCII

Write-Host "`nBuilt (version $version, commit $($git.Short)):" -ForegroundColor Green
Get-ChildItem $output -File | Select-Object Name, @{n='MB';e={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize
```
Remember that `gcc` here is the host MinGW-w64 `gcc` (already on PATH through `/mingw64/bin`).

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** (append to `lib/common.ps1`)

```powershell
function Set-VersionsEntry {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Version, [string]$Url, [string]$PageUrl)
    $j = Get-Content $Path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $entry = [ordered]@{ name = 'nv1Quake'; version = $Version; url = $Url; pageUrl = $PageUrl }
    if ($j.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'nv1quake') { $j.nv1quake = [pscustomobject]$entry }
    else { $j | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'nv1quake' -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]$entry) }
    ($j | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6) | Set-Content $Path -Encoding UTF8
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Write `publish-to-site.ps1`**

```powershell
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Uploads the nv1Quake installers to R2, updates versions.json and apps/nv1quake.html in the
    site repo, and pushes. DRY RUN unless -Publish is given.
#>
param(
    [string]$SiteRepo = 'X:\repos\AbnormalitySoftwareWebsite',
    [switch]$Publish
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. "$PSScriptRoot\lib\common.ps1"

$version = Get-NV1Version
$output  = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'output'
$files = @(
    "NV1Quake-$version-Emulated-Setup.exe",
    "NV1Quake-$version-Win95-Setup.exe",
    "NV1Quake-$version-DOS-Setup.exe",
    "NV1Quake-$version-source.zip"
)
foreach ($f in $files) { if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $output $f))) { throw "Missing $f in output\ - run build-installers.ps1 first" } }
Assert-NoGameData -Dir $output
if (-not (Test-Path $SiteRepo)) { throw "Site repo not found at $SiteRepo" }

$info = @{}
foreach ($f in $files) {
    $p = Join-Path $output $f
    $info[$f] = @{ Size = '{0:N1} MB' -f ((Get-Item $p).Length / 1MB); Sha = (Get-FileHash $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() }
}
$values = @{
    VERSION = $version
    EMU_FILE = $files[0]; EMU_SIZE = $info[$files[0]].Size; EMU_SHA = $info[$files[0]].Sha
    W95_FILE = $files[1]; W95_SIZE = $info[$files[1]].Size; W95_SHA = $info[$files[1]].Sha
    DOS_FILE = $files[2]; DOS_SIZE = $info[$files[2]].Size; DOS_SHA = $info[$files[2]].Sha
    SRC_FILE = $files[3]; SRC_SIZE = $info[$files[3]].Size; SRC_SHA = $info[$files[3]].Sha
}
$page = Expand-Template -Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'site\nv1quake.html.in') -Values $values
$pagePath = Join-Path $SiteRepo 'apps\nv1quake.html'
$versionsPath = Join-Path $SiteRepo 'versions.json'

Write-Host "Version $version" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$files | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  R2: abnormalitysoftware-downloads/NV1Quake/$_  ($($info[$_].Size))" }
Write-Host "  page:     $pagePath"
Write-Host "  versions: nv1quake -> $version (emulated installer)"
if (-not $Publish) { Write-Host "`nDRY RUN - nothing uploaded or changed. Re-run with -Publish." -ForegroundColor Yellow; return }

Push-Location $SiteRepo
try {
    foreach ($f in $files) {
        npx --yes wrangler@4 r2 object put "abnormalitysoftware-downloads/NV1Quake/$f" --file (Join-Path $output $f) --remote
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "wrangler upload of $f failed" }
    }
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($pagePath, $page, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Set-VersionsEntry -Path $versionsPath -Version $version `
        -Url "https://abnormalitysoftware.com/dl/NV1Quake/$($files[0])" -PageUrl 'https://abnormalitysoftware.com/apps/nv1quake'
    # Only our own two files: this repo often has unrelated uncommitted work.
    git add -- 'apps/nv1quake.html' 'versions.json'
    git commit -m "Add nv1Quake $version product page and versions.json entry"
    git push
} finally { Pop-Location }
Write-Host 'Published.' -ForegroundColor Green
```

## Self-review (against the spec)

- **Coverage:** orchestrator and repeatable scripts (Task 7); three installer technologies (Tasks 4-6); logo as installer, uninstall, shortcut, game-exe and wizard art (Tasks 3-6); licence files, community statement, credit line, no game data (Tasks 1, 2, 5, 6, 7); source zip (Task 7); product page and dry-run-by-default publishing that touches only its own site files (Task 8); open licensing risks recorded in `NOTICE.TXT` and `ISSUES.md` (Tasks 2, 9); stale Win95 binary fixed by `-Rebuild` and Release refresh (Task 7); documentation (Task 9).
- **Placeholders:** none; the only generated stub (`dos/notice_text.h`) is overwritten by the build and is defined in Task 6. Task 8's page body is specified section by section because its markup must be copied from the live `diskpixie.html`, which the implementer reads at that step.
- **Type consistency:** `Stage-Variant`, `New-LegalFiles`, `Assert-NoGameData`, `Expand-Template`, `ConvertTo-NoticeHeader`, `Set-VersionsEntry`, `New-SourceZip`, `Invoke-Build` are defined once and used with the same signatures. The DOS `GameProfile` field order (`appName`, `defaultInstallDir`, `title`, `showGameOptions`, `configure`) matches in `dosmain.h` and `nv1quake_dos_main.c`. The Win95 profile matches the existing six-field struct.
- **Known risks the implementer must watch:** the vendored Win32 engine was out of sync with its header (fixed in Task 5 Step 2); the exact MinGW link libraries for the engine should be checked against Fragged's duke3d build; `nc_memcpy` may not exist in `nocrt.h`; the DOS packer rejects non-8.3 names.
